the Veda, Vedic scripture (first compound member)
sacrifice (second member)

study, learning (veda-yajña-adhyayana: 'the study of the Vedas and [performance of] sacrifice', instr. pl. 'by Vedic study and sacrifice'; -aiḥ + n- → -air n-, visarga sandhi before a voiced consonant)
not (repeated before each item in the list)

gift, gift-giving (dānaiḥ: instr. pl. 'by gifts'; the Wikisource print breaks the pāda here, carrying the -r- that its visarga becomes before the voiced n- of na to the head of the next line — see note)
gift (r: the leftover consonant of dānaiḥ's sandhi before the voiced n- of na, -aiḥ + n- → -air n- [visarga turning to r], completing dānair begun on the previous line — see note)
not
and
rite, ritual act (kriyābhiḥ: instr. pl.; -iḥ + n- → -ir n-, visarga sandhi before a voiced consonant, the same pattern as vedayajñādhyayanaiḥ na above)
not
austerity (tapobhiḥ: instr. pl.; -as + bh- → -o bh-, the same -as-stem visarga sandhi as tejomayam in v.47)
fierce, severe (instr. pl., agreeing with tapobhiḥ; -iḥ + u- → -ir u-, visarga before a vowel)
thus, such (first compound member)
form (evaṃ-rūpa: 'of this form, of such a kind', nom. sg. masc., predicate)

possible, able to be done (gerundive of śak; nom. sg. masc., agreeing with the understood aham, 'I am able'; the expected visarga before the following vowel a- is simply dropped here, without the usual guṇa to -o — an epic-Sanskrit metrical variant, not the regular rule; contrast evaṃvidho 'rjuna in v.54 just below, and samo 'ham at 9.29, where the regular rule applies)
I (nom. sg., subject)
man (first compound member)
world (nṛ-loka: 'the world of men', loc. sg.)
to see (draṣṭum: infinitive, here in a passive sense 'to be seen', completing śakyaḥ)
you (compound stem, 'other than you')
other (anyena: instr. sg., 'by one other than you', repeated from v.47)
the Kuru clan (first compound member)
foremost hero, champion (kuru-pravīra: 'O hero of the Kurus', vocative, addressed to Arjuna)

sentences.l: Not by study-of-the-Vedas-and-sacrifice, not by gifts, not by rituals, not by fierce austerities, of such a form am I able, in the world of men, to be seen by anyone other than you, O hero of the Kurus.
sentences.i: Not by studying the Vedas or by sacrifice, not by giving gifts, not by rites, not by the fiercest austerities can I, in such a form, be seen in the world of men by anyone but you, mighty hero of the Kurus.
sentences.n: This verse spans the printed page: the Wikisource line ends दानै- and the next begins र्न, splitting the single sandhi-word dānaiḥ + na ('by gifts' + 'not') across the pāda break, exactly as sura-indra-loka- / m aśnanti was split at ch09 v.20; the entries here follow that precedent, tiling the source exactly and dividing the reading across the two tokens (dānai- / r na), the visarga of dānaiḥ surfacing as -r- before the voiced n- of na (-aiḥ + n- → -air n-), the same pattern as this verse's own vedayajñādhyayanair na and kriyābhir na. The verse repeats na four times, once before each instrumental (veda-yajña-adhyayanaiḥ, dānaiḥ, kriyābhiḥ, tapobhiḥ) — a standard anaphora of negation. Śakyaḥ ... draṣṭum is a gerundive-plus-infinitive construction, 'is able to be seen'; here and again in v.54, śakya's own visarga drops before the following aham without the usual guṇa to -o (contrast samo 'ham at 9.29) — an epic-Sanskrit metrical variant, not the regular rule.

sentences.t:
मा ते व्यथा मा च विमूढभावो ।
दृष्ट्वा रूपं घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम् ।
व्यपेतभीः प्रीतमनाः पुनस्त्वं ।
तदेव मे रूपमिदं प्रपश्य ॥
sentences.tr:
mā te vyathā mā ca vimūḍha-bhāvaḥ |
dṛṣṭvā rūpam ghoram īdṛk mama idam |
vyapeta-bhīḥ prīta-manāḥ punaḥ tvam |
tat eva me rūpam idam prapaśya ||

morph.gloss: do not, let there not be (prohibitive particle)
you (te: enclitic gen. sg. 'your')
fear, agitation, distress (nom. sg. fem., subject of an understood 'be')
nor, let there not be (repeated)
and
bewildered, confounded (past participle of vi-muh; first compound member)
state, condition (vimūḍha-bhāva: 'a state of bewilderment', nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ before d- → -o)
to see (dṛṣṭvā: gerund 'having seen')
form (acc. sg. neut., object of dṛṣṭvā)
terrible, dreadful (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with rūpam)
such, of this kind (nom./acc. sg. neut. īdṛk, the stem's -ś reverting to its velar allomorph -k before a consonant, and assimilating further to -ṅ before the following nasal m-: ghoram īdṛṅ mama)
I (mama: gen. sg. 'my, of mine')
this (nom. sg. neut.; mama + idam: a + i → e)
departed, gone away (past participle of vi-apa-i; first compound member)
fear (vyapeta-bhī: 'whose fear is gone', nom. sg. masc. bahuvrīhi)
pleased, gladdened (past participle of prī; first compound member)
mind (prīta-manas: 'whose mind is glad', nom. sg. masc. bahuvrīhi)
again (punaḥ: -aḥ + t- → -as t-, as in duryodhanas tadā at 1.2)
you (nom. sg., subject)
that (tat: acc. sg. neut., referring to rūpam; -t + e- → -d e-)
I (me: enclitic gen. sg. 'my')
form (acc. sg. neut.)
this (acc. sg. neut., in apposition to rūpam; rūpam + idam: -m before the vowel i- simply written joined, no phonetic change)
to see, behold (prapaśya: imperative 2nd sg. 'behold!')

sentences.l: Let there not be fear of yours, nor confusion, at having seen this terrible form of mine, such as this; fear gone, mind glad, again you — that very form of mine, this, behold!
sentences.i: Do not be afraid, and do not be bewildered at having seen this terrible form of mine. Be free of fear again, your mind at ease: look, here is that same form of mine once more.
sentences.n: Mā with an understood verb of being is the standard Sanskrit prohibitive: te vyathā mā [bhūt], 'let there not be fear of yours'. Vimūḍha-bhāva and vyapeta-bhīḥ / prīta-manāḥ are bahuvrīhi compounds naming Arjuna's state, first terrified and then restored. Sandhi: विमूढभावो is vimūḍha-bhāvaḥ, -aḥ before d- → -o; घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम् packs ghoram + īdṛś (the stem's -ś reverting to its velar allomorph -k, then assimilating to -ṅ before the nasal m- of mama) + mama + idam (a + i → e); पुनस्त्वं is punaḥ + tvam (-aḥ + t- → -as t-, as in duryodhanas tadā at 1.2); तदेव is tat + eva (-t + e- → -d e-).

sentences.t: सञ्जय उवाच
sentences.tr: sañjaya uvāca
sentences.l: Sañjaya said

morph.gloss: Sañjaya, the king's minister and charioteer, who reports the battle to him (nom. sg.)
to speak (uvāca: perfect 3rd sg. 'said')

sentences.t:
इत्यर्जुनं वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा ।
स्वकं रूपं दर्शयामास भूयः ।
आश्वासयामास च भीतमेनं ।
भूत्वा पुनः सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा ॥
sentences.tr:
iti arjunam vāsudevaḥ tathā uktvā |
svakam rūpam darśayāmāsa bhūyaḥ |
āśvāsayāmāsa ca bhītam enam |
bhūtvā punaḥ saumya-vapuḥ mahā-ātmā ||

morph.gloss: thus (closes the reported speech of vv.47-49; iti + arjunam: -i + a- → -y a-)
'son of Vasudeva', Kṛṣṇa's patronymic (nom. sg.; -aḥ + t- → -as t-, as in duryodhanas tadā at 1.2)
thus, in that way (tathā + uktvā: ā + u → o, guṇa)
to speak (uktvā: gerund 'having spoken')
one's own (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with rūpam)
form (acc. sg. neut., object of darśayāmāsa)
to see (darśayāmāsa: causative periphrastic perfect 3rd sg. 'he showed, displayed', formed with -ām + āsa 'did')
again, once more (adverb)
to take comfort, be reassured (āśvāsayāmāsa: causative periphrastic perfect 3rd sg. 'he comforted, reassured', the same -ām + āsa formation as darśayāmāsa)
and
frightened (past participle of bhī; acc. sg. masc.)
this, he (enam: acc. sg. masc. pronoun, 'him'; bhītam + enam: -m before the vowel e- simply written joined, no phonetic change)
to become (bhūtvā: gerund 'having become')
again
gentle, mild (first compound member)
body, form (saumya-vapus: 'gentle-bodied', nom. sg. masc.; -uḥ + m- → -ur m-, visarga sandhi of a -uḥ ending before a voiced consonant, the same rule as before a vowel, cf. yajur eva at 9.17)
great (first member of a second compound)
self, soul (mahā-ātman: 'great-souled', nom. sg., in apposition to saumya-vapuḥ, both describing Vāsudeva; a + ā → ā)

sentences.l: Thus to Arjuna, Vāsudeva having so spoken, his own form he displayed again; and comforted him, frightened, having become again gentle-bodied, the great-souled one.
sentences.i: Having spoken thus to Arjuna, Vāsudeva showed his own form once more, and comforted him in his fright, becoming again the great-souled one of gentle body.
sentences.n: The narrator's voice returns to close the theophany, as it did at the end of chapter 1. Vāsudeva, 'son of Vasudeva', is Kṛṣṇa's patronymic. Darśayāmāsa and āśvāsayāmāsa are both periphrastic perfects (root + -ām + āsa 'did'), the regular way Sanskrit forms the perfect tense of causative verbs. Saumya-vapuḥ mahātmā, 'gentle-bodied, great-souled', marks Kṛṣṇa's return to his familiar human form after the terrifying cosmic one. Sandhi: इत्यर्जुनं is iti + arjunam (-i + a- → -y a-); वासुदेवस्तथोक्त्वा packs vāsudevaḥ + tathā (-aḥ + t- → -as t-) + tathā + uktvā (ā + u → o); सौम्यवपुर्महात्मा is saumya-vapuḥ + mahā-ātmā (-uḥ + m- → -ur m-, the same visarga sandhi as before a vowel, e.g. yajur eva at 9.17, here before a voiced consonant instead).

sentences.t: अर्जुन उवाच
sentences.tr: arjuna uvāca
sentences.l: Arjuna said

morph.gloss: Arjuna, the third Pāṇḍava, the great archer (nom. sg.)
to speak (uvāca: perfect 3rd sg. 'said')

sentences.t:
दृष्ट्वेदं मानुषं रूपं तव सौम्यं जनार्दन ।
इदानीमस्मि संवृत्तः सचेताः प्रकृतिं गतः ॥
sentences.tr:
dṛṣṭvā idam mānuṣam rūpam tava saumyam janārdana |
idānīm asmi saṃvṛttaḥ sa-cetāḥ prakṛtim gataḥ ||

morph.gloss: to see (dṛṣṭvā: gerund 'having seen'; -ā + i- → -e-)
this (acc. sg. neut., object of dṛṣṭvā)
human (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with rūpam)
form (acc. sg. neut., in apposition to idam)
you (tava: gen. sg. 'your')
gentle, mild (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with rūpam)
'rouser' or 'tormentor of men', an epithet of Kṛṣṇa (vocative)
now (adverb; idānīm + asmi: -m before the vowel a- simply written joined, no phonetic change)
to become, turn into, settle (saṃvṛtta: past participle, nom. sg. masc., predicate: 'become, restored')
with, possessing (prefix)
mind, consciousness (sa-cetas: 'possessing [normal] consciousness, composed in mind', nom. sg. masc. bahuvrīhi)
nature (acc. sg. fem., object of gataḥ, 'gone to [my own] nature')
to go (gata: past participle 'gone', nom. sg. masc.)

sentences.l: Having seen this human form of yours, gentle, O rouser-of-men, now I am become composed-minded, returned to [my own] nature.
sentences.i: Seeing this human form of yours again, gentle Janārdana, I have come back to myself; my mind is calm, and I am restored to my own nature.
sentences.n: The meter returns here to the two-line anuṣṭubh/śloka that carries the rest of the poem, after the four-line triṣṭubh of verses 47-50 that marked the theophany's high point. Saṃvṛttaḥ ... prakṛtim gataḥ, 'become ... gone to [my own] nature', echoes language used elsewhere in the poem for cosmic dissolution and return, now applied to Arjuna's return to himself. Sandhi: दृष्ट्वेदं is dṛṣṭvā + idam (ā + i → e); इदानीमस्मि is idānīm + asmi, joined without change.

sentences.t: श्रीभगवानुवाच
sentences.tr: śrībhagavān uvāca
sentences.l: The Blessed Lord said

morph.gloss: holy, glorious (honorific prefix)
the Blessed One, the Lord — Kṛṣṇa's title as speaker (nom. sg. bhagavān; -n + u- written joined)
to speak (uvāca: perfect 3rd sg. 'said')

sentences.t:
सुदुर्दर्शमिदं रूपं दृष्टवानसि यन्मम ।
देवा अप्यस्य रूपस्य नित्यं दर्शनकाङ्क्षिणः ॥
sentences.tr:
su-durdarśam idam rūpam dṛṣṭavān asi yat mama |
devāḥ api asya rūpasya nityam darśana-kāṅkṣiṇaḥ ||

morph.gloss: very, exceedingly (intensifying prefix)
hard, difficult (negative prefix)
seeing, sight (su-dur-darśa: 'very hard to see', from dṛś, acc. sg. neut., agreeing with rūpam)
this (acc. sg. neut., in apposition; su-durdarśam + idam: -m before the vowel i- simply written joined, no phonetic change)
form (acc. sg. neut., object of dṛṣṭavān asi)
to see (dṛṣṭavān: perfect active participle 'having seen', nom. sg. masc.; joined with the following auxiliary without change, as bhagavān uvāca is written joined)
to be (asi: present 2nd sg. 'you are'; together, dṛṣṭavān asi is a periphrastic perfect, 'you have seen')
which (yat: acc. sg. neut. relative, referring to rūpam; -t + m- → -n m-, as in yan me at v.47)
I (mama: gen. sg. 'my, of mine')

god, deity (nom. pl., subject; the visarga of an -āḥ ending simply drops before a following vowel, with no merger — unlike the -aḥ-before-a rule seen with śakya in v.48, this -āḥ form just loses its visarga, cf. purūṣā dharmasyāsya at 9.3)
even, also (api + asya: -i + a- → -y a-)
this (asya: gen. sg. neut., 'of this [form]')
form (gen. sg.)
always, constantly (adverb)
sight, seeing, beholding (first compound member)
desiring, longing for (darśana-kāṅkṣin: 'longing to see', nom. pl. masc., predicate)

sentences.l: Very-hard-to-see is this form which of mine you have seen; the gods too, of this form, always, are longing-to-see.
sentences.i: This form of mine that you have seen is very hard to see; even the gods are forever longing to behold it.
sentences.n: Kṛṣṇa begins the chapter's closing teaching on how the cosmic form is, and is not, to be reached. Su-durdarśam stacks two prefixes on darśa 'sight' — su- intensifying, dur- 'hard' — for 'extremely hard to see'. Dṛṣṭavān asi is a periphrastic perfect, 'you have seen' (participle dṛṣṭavān + auxiliary asi), repeated in the next verse. Sandhi: सुदुर्दर्शमिदं is su-durdarśam + idam, joined without change; यन्मम is yat + mama (-t + m- → -n m-, as in yan me at v.47); देवा अप्यस्य is devāḥ + api (an -āḥ ending simply loses its visarga before any vowel, with no merger, unlike the -aḥ-before-a rule seen with śakya in v.48) + api + asya (-i + a- → -y a-).

sentences.t:
नाहं वेदैर्न तपसा न दानेन न चेज्यया ।
शक्य एवंविधो द्रष्टुं दृष्टवानसि मां यथा ॥
sentences.tr:
na aham vedaiḥ na tapasā na dānena na ca ijyayā |
śakyaḥ evaṃvidhaḥ draṣṭum dṛṣṭavān asi mām yathā ||

morph.gloss: not (na + aham: a + a → ā)
I (nom. sg., subject)
the Veda (vedaiḥ: instr. pl. 'by the Vedas'; -aiḥ + n- → -air n-, as in vedayajñādhyayanaiḥ na at v.48)
not
austerity (instr. sg.)
not
gift, gift-giving (instr. sg.)
not
and (ca + ijyayā: a + i → e)
sacrifice, worship (instr. sg.)

possible, able to be done (gerundive of śak; nom. sg. masc., predicate; here the visarga drops regularly before the following vowel e- of evaṃvidhaḥ, the ordinary rule for -aḥ before a non-a vowel — contrast the irregular śakya aham of v.48 and v.54)
thus, such (first compound member)
kind, manner (evaṃ-vidha: 'of this kind', nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ before d- → -o)
to see (draṣṭum: infinitive, passive sense 'to be seen')
to see (dṛṣṭavān: perfect active participle 'having seen', nom. sg. masc.)
to be (asi: present 2nd sg.; together, 'you have seen', repeated from v.52)
I (acc. sg. 'me')
as, in the way that

sentences.l: Not I by the Vedas, not by austerity, not by gift-giving, and not by sacrifice; able, of such a kind, to be seen, as you have seen me.
sentences.i: Not by the Vedas, not by austerity, not by giving, and not by sacrifice can I be seen — only as you have seen me.
sentences.n: This verse restates verse 48's fourfold denial from the far side of the vision, now naming ijyā 'sacrifice, worship' in place of that verse's kriyā 'ritual act'. Evaṃvidhaḥ draṣṭum, 'to be seen in such a manner', picks up evaṃrūpaḥ ... draṣṭum from v.48 almost word for word. Sandhi: नाहं is na + aham (a + a → ā); वेदैर्न is vedaiḥ + na (-aiḥ + n- → -air n-, as in veda-yajña-adhyayanaiḥ na at v.48); चेज्यया is ca + ijyayā (a + i → e); in शक्य एवंविधो, śakyaḥ's visarga drops regularly before the vowel e- of evaṃvidhaḥ — the ordinary rule for -aḥ before a non-a vowel, unlike the anomalous śakya aham of v.48 and v.54.

sentences.t:
भक्त्या त्वनन्यया शक्य अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन ।
ज्ञातुं द्रष्टुं च तत्त्वेन प्रवेष्टुं च परंतप ॥
sentences.tr:
bhaktyā tu ananyayā śakyaḥ aham evaṃvidhaḥ arjuna |
jñātum draṣṭum ca tattvena praveṣṭum ca parantapa ||

morph.gloss: devotion (instr. sg. 'through devotion')
but (tu + ananyayā: u + a → va, yaṇ sandhi)
not other, undivided, exclusive (ananyayā: instr. sg. fem., agreeing with bhaktyā)

possible, able to be done (gerundive of śak; nom. sg. masc., agreeing with the understood aham; the visarga is again dropped here before the following vowel a- of aham without the usual guṇa to -o, the same irregular pattern as v.48)
I (nom. sg., subject; aham + evaṃvidhaḥ: -m before the vowel e- simply written joined, no phonetic change)
thus, such (first compound member)
kind, manner (evaṃ-vidha: 'of this kind', nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ + a- → -o with avagraha, the regular pattern)
Arjuna (vocative)
to know (jñātum: infinitive)
to see (draṣṭum: infinitive)
and
true nature, reality, essence (instr. sg. 'in [my true] reality, in truth')
to enter into (praveṣṭum: infinitive)
and
'scorcher of the foe', an epithet of Arjuna (vocative)

sentences.l: By devotion, but, undivided, able am I, of such a kind, Arjuna, to be known, and to be seen in [my true] reality, and to be entered, O scorcher of the foe.
sentences.i: But through devotion that turns nowhere else, Arjuna, I can, in such a form, be known and seen in truth and entered into, scorcher of the foe.
sentences.n: The chapter's answer to its own riddle: what the Vedas, austerity, gift-giving and sacrifice cannot reach, ananyayā bhaktyā, 'undivided devotion', does. Bhakti is translated here as 'devotion' rather than left untranslated, since it is not on conventions.md's list of untranslated terms (dharma, yoga, brahman, the guṇas, sāṃkhya) — a choice worth revisiting once ch.12, named for it (Bhaktiyoga), is reached. Three infinitives share the one śakya: jñātum 'to know', draṣṭum 'to see', praveṣṭum 'to enter'. Sandhi: त्वनन्यया is tu + ananyayā (u + a → va, yaṇ sandhi); अहमेवंविधोऽर्जुन packs aham + evaṃvidhaḥ (joined without change) + evaṃvidhaḥ + arjuna (-aḥ + a- → -o with avagraha, the regular pattern — unlike śakya's own irregular elision earlier in the same line).

sentences.t:
मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो मद्भक्तः सङ्गवर्जितः ।
निर्वैरः सर्वभूतेषु यः स मामेति पाण्डव ॥
sentences.tr:
mat-karma-kṛt mat-paramaḥ mad-bhaktaḥ saṅga-varjitaḥ |
nirvairaḥ sarva-bhūteṣu yaḥ saḥ mām eti pāṇḍava ||

morph.gloss: me, my (compound stem form of aham; devoices to mat- before a voiceless consonant, here k-, contrast the voiced mad-bhaktaḥ just below where it stands before the voiced bh-)
action, work (second member)
doer, agent (from kṛ; mat-karma-kṛt: 'one who does my work', nom. sg. masc.; kṛt + mat-: -t + m- → -n m-, assimilation)
me (compound stem, again devoicing to mat- before the voiceless p- of parama)
supreme (mat-parama: 'having me as the highest [goal]', nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ before m- → -o)
me, my (compound stem, here unchanged before the voiced bh-)
devotee (mad-bhakta: 'my devotee', nom. sg. masc.)
attachment, clinging (from sañj, 'to cling'; first compound member)
devoid of, free from (past participle of vṛj 'to exclude'; saṅga-varjita: 'free from attachment', nom. sg. masc.)
without, free from (negative prefix)
hostility, enmity (nirvaira: 'free from hostility', nom. sg. masc.)
all (first compound member)
being (sarva-bhūta: 'all beings', loc. pl. 'toward all beings')
who (yaḥ: nom. sg. masc. relative)
he (saḥ: nom. sg. masc.; the visarga is dropped before any consonant for this pronoun specifically, not merely voiced ones — the same exception already seen at 1.13's sa ghoṣaḥ and 1.19's sa śabdaḥ)
I (mām: acc. sg. 'me')
to go, come, attain (eti: present 3rd sg. 'goes, attains'; mām + eti: -m before the vowel e- simply written joined, no phonetic change)
'son of Pāṇḍu', addressed to Arjuna (vocative)

sentences.l: My-work-doing, me-as-highest, my devotee, attachment-free; without hostility toward all beings — who, he comes to me, O son of Pāṇḍu.
sentences.i: One who does my work, holds me as the highest goal, is devoted to me, free of attachment, and without hostility toward any being — that one comes to me, Pāṇḍava.
sentences.n: The chapter's summary teaching and its closing verse, echoing the four-part formula of 9.34 (man-manāḥ, mad-bhaktaḥ...) but built here as a single relative-correlative sentence (yaḥ ... saḥ, 'who ... he') and ending, as ch.9 does, on the promise of reaching Kṛṣṇa. Bhakti/bhakta are again translated ('devotee') rather than left as bare Sanskrit, matching v.54 and ch.9's practice throughout. Sandhi: मत्कर्मकृन्मत्परमो packs mat-karma-kṛt (mad devoicing to mat- before the voiceless k-, a pattern new in this chapter; contrast mad-bhaktaḥ just after, where mad stays voiced before the voiced bh-) + mat-paramaḥ (kṛt + mat-: -t + m- → -n m-) + mat-paramaḥ + mad-bhaktaḥ (-aḥ before m- → -o); स is saḥ with its visarga dropped before the following consonant, the same pronoun-specific exception already seen at 1.13's sa ghoṣaḥ and 1.19's sa śabdaḥ — saḥ and eṣaḥ drop the visarga before any consonant, not only voiced ones.

glossary.ब्रह्माणमीशं: brahmāṇam īśam — Brahmā — Brahmā, the creator-god of the traditional cosmology (a proper name; acc. sg. brahmāṇam; joined directly before the vowel ī- of īśam, no change); īśa — lord, ruler (acc. sg. īśam, in apposition to brahmāṇam: 'Brahmā the lord'; -m before the consonant k- of the next word → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.कमलासनस्थ-: kamala-āsana-stha- — kamala — lotus (first compound member); āsana — seat (second member, kamala-āsana 'lotus-seat'); stha — seated, situated (third member: 'seated on the lotus-seat', describing Brahmā, acc. sg. kamalāsanastham; the Wikisource print line breaks this compound oddly across the pāda break, dropping its final -m — see note)
glossary.मृषींश्च: m ṛṣīn ca — stha — seated (m: the final -m of kamalāsana-stham, completing the word begun on the previous print line — see note); ṛṣi — sage, seer (ṛṣīn: acc. pl. masc.; -n + c- → -ṃś c-); ca — and
glossary.सर्वानुरगांश्च: sarvān uragān ca — sarva — all (acc. pl.; joined directly before the vowel u- of uragān, no change); uraga — serpent, snake-deity, a Nāga (lit. 'going on the belly'; acc. pl.; -n + c- → -ṃś c-); ca — and
glossary.दिव्यान्: divyān — divya — divine, celestial (acc. pl. masc., agreeing with uragān)
glossary.अनेकबाहूदरवक्त्रनेत्रं: aneka-bāhu-udara-vaktra-netram — aneka — many, numerous (first compound member); bāhu — arm (second member; -u + u- → -ū- with udara, undone at the hyphen); udara — belly (third member); vaktra — mouth, face (fourth member); netra — eye (aneka-bāhu-udara-vaktra-netra: 'having many arms, bellies, mouths and eyes', bahuvrīhi, acc. sg. masc. -netram, describing tvām; -m before the consonant p- of paśyāmi → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.त्वां: tvām — tvam — you (acc. sg. tvām, the vulgate's anusvāra spelling; BORI reads tvā, the enclitic accusative, instead — see note)
glossary.सर्वतोऽनन्तरूपम्: sarvataḥ ananta-rūpam — sarvatas — from all sides, everywhere (adverb; -as + a- → -o, with the avagraha marking the lost a-); ananta — endless, infinite (first compound member); rūpa — form (ananta-rūpa: 'of infinite form', acc. sg., agreeing with tvām)
glossary.नान्तं: na antam — na — not (na + a- → nā-); anta — end (acc. sg. neut.; -m before the consonant n- of the next word → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.मध्यं: madhyam — madhya — middle (acc. sg. neut.; -m before n- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.पुनस्तवादिं: punaḥ tava ādim — punar — again, moreover (punaḥ: before the consonant t- → -as t-); tvam — you (tava: gen. sg. 'your'); ādi — beginning (ādim: acc. sg.; -a + ā- → -ā-; -m before the vowel-initial paśyāmi of the next line is retained as written -m — see note)
glossary.विश्वेश्वर: viśva-īśvara — viśva — universe, all (first compound member); īśvara — lord, ruler (viśva-īśvara: 'Lord of the universe', vocative sg., addressed to Kṛṣṇa; -a + ī- → -e-)
glossary.विश्वरूप: viśva-rūpa — viśva — universe, all (first compound member); rūpa — form (viśva-rūpa: 'having the universe as your form, universal-formed', vocative sg., addressed to Kṛṣṇa — the epithet that gives this chapter its name)
glossary.किरीटिनं: kirīṭinam — kirīṭin — crowned, wearing a diadem (from kirīṭa 'crown, diadem' + the possessive suffix -in; acc. sg. masc., describing tvām; -m before the consonant g- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.गदिनं: gadinam — gadin — bearing a mace (from gadā 'mace, club' + -in; acc. sg. masc.; -m before c- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.चक्रिणं: cakriṇam — cakrin — bearing a discus (from cakra 'discus, wheel' + -in; acc. sg. masc.; -m before the vowel-initial ca is retained as written -m, but before a following consonant would nasalize — here followed by च, a consonant, so -m before c- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.तेजोराशिं: tejo-rāśim — tejas — brilliance, splendor, fiery energy (first compound member; -as + r- → -o r-); rāśi — heap, mass (tejo-rāśi: 'a mass of radiance', acc. sg., describing tvām)
glossary.सर्वतो: sarvataḥ — sarvatas — on every side, everywhere (adverb; -as + d- → -o d-)
glossary.दीप्तिमन्तम्: dīptimantam — dīptimat — blazing, radiant, possessing splendor (acc. sg. masc., describing tvām)
glossary.दुर्निरीक्ष्यं: durnirīkṣyam — dur — hard, difficult (prefix); nir-īkṣ — to look at, gaze upon (nirīkṣya: gerundive 'to be looked at'; dur-nirīkṣya: 'hard to behold', acc. sg. masc.; -m before s- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.समन्ता-: samantā- — samanta — all-encompassing, all sides (samantāt: ablative used adverbially, 'on all sides, all around'; the Wikisource print line breaks this word oddly across the pāda break, dropping its final -t — see note)
glossary.द्दीप्तानलार्कद्युतिमप्रमेयम्: d dīpta-anala-arka-dyutim aprameyam — samantāt — on all sides (d: the final -t of samantāt, voiced to -d by sandhi before the following d-, completing the word begun on the previous print line — see note); dīp — to blaze, shine (dīpta: past participle 'blazing', first member of the following compound; -a + a- → -ā- with anala, undone at the hyphen); anala — fire (second member; -a + a- → -ā- with arka, undone at the hyphen); arka — sun (third member); dyuti — light, radiance (dīpta-anala-arka-dyuti: 'the blazing light of fire and sun', fourth member, describing tvām, acc. sg. -dyutim); aprameya — immeasurable, unfathomable (acc. sg. masc., agreeing with tvām)
glossary.त्वमक्षरं: tvam akṣaram — tvam — you (nom. sg., predicate subject of an implied 'are'; joined directly before the vowel a- of akṣaram, no change); akṣara — the Imperishable, the indestructible (nom. sg. neut., used as a name for the changeless absolute; -m before the consonant p- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.वेदितव्यं: veditavyam — vid — to know (veditavya: gerundive 'to be known', nom. sg. neut.: 'the object of knowledge')
glossary.त्वमस्य: tvam asya — tvam — you (nom. sg.; joined directly before the vowel a- of asya, no change); idam — this (asya: gen. sg. neut. 'of this', referring to viśvasya)
glossary.विश्वस्य: viśvasya — viśva — universe, all (gen. sg. 'of the universe')
glossary.परं: param — para — supreme, highest (here param: nom. sg. neut.; -m before n- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.निधानम्: nidhānam — nidhāna — receptacle, resting-place, treasure-house (nom. sg. neut.)
glossary.त्वमव्ययः: tvam avyayaḥ — tvam — you (nom. sg.; joined directly before the vowel a- of avyayaḥ, no change); avyaya — imperishable, undiminishing (nom. sg. masc.)
glossary.शाश्वतधर्मगोप्ता: śāśvata-dharma-goptā — śāśvata — eternal, everlasting (first compound member); dharma — the sacred order, the cosmic law (second member, kept untranslated in idiomatic sense per house style); gup — to guard, protect (goptṛ: agent noun 'guardian', third member, nom. sg.: 'the guardian of eternal dharma')
glossary.सनातनस्त्वं: sanātanaḥ tvam — sanātana — eternal, ancient, everlasting (nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ + t- → -as t-); tvam — you (nom. sg.; -m before the consonant p- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.पुरुषो: puruṣaḥ — puruṣa — the Person, the cosmic Spirit (a central Sāṃkhya and Upaniṣadic term for the ultimate self; nom. sg.; -aḥ before m- → -o)
glossary.मतो: mataḥ — man — to think (mata: past participle 'thought, deemed, considered', nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ before m- → -o)
glossary.अनादिमध्यान्तमनन्तवीर्य-: an-ādi-madhya-antam ananta-vīrya- — an — not, without (negative prefix, first member); ādi — beginning (second member); madhya — middle (third member); anta — end (an-ādi-madhya-anta: 'having no beginning, middle, or end', bahuvrīhi, acc. sg. masc. antam, agreeing with tvām; joined directly before the vowel a- of ananta, no change); ananta — endless, infinite (separate word, first member of the following compound); vīrya — power, valor, might (ananta-vīrya: 'of infinite power', acc. sg. masc.; the Wikisource print line breaks this word oddly across the pāda break, dropping its final -m — see note)
glossary.मनन्तबाहुं: m ananta-bāhum — vīrya — power (m: the final -m of ananta-vīryam, completing the word begun on the previous print line — see note; joined directly to the following vowel a-, no sandhi change); ananta — infinite (first compound member); bāhu — arm (ananta-bāhu: 'infinite-armed', acc. sg. masc. bāhum, agreeing with tvām; -m before ś- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.शशिसूर्यनेत्रम्: śaśi-sūrya-netram — śaśi — moon (first member); sūrya — sun (second member); netra — eye (śaśi-sūrya-netra: 'having the moon and sun for eyes', acc. sg. masc., agreeing with tvām)
glossary.दीप्तहुताशवक्त्रं: dīpta-hutāśa-vaktram — dīpta — blazing, flaming (past participle of dīp; first member); hutāśa — fire (lit. 'eater of oblations', an old epithet of Agni used here as a plain word for fire; second member); vaktra — mouth, face (dīpta-hutāśa-vaktra: 'whose mouth is blazing fire', acc. sg. masc.; -m before s- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.स्वतेजसा: sva-tejasā — sva — own (first member); tejas — brilliance, fiery energy (sva-tejas: 'by your own radiance', instr. sg.)
glossary.विश्वमिदं: viśvam idam — viśva — universe, all (acc. sg. neut. 'the universe'; joined directly before the vowel i- of idam, no change); idam — this (acc. sg. neut.; -m before the consonant t- of the next word → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.तपन्तम्: tapantam — tap — to heat, scorch, burn (tapant: present participle, acc. sg. masc., agreeing with tvām: 'burning, scorching')
glossary.द्यावापृथिव्योरिदमन्तरं: dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ idam antaram — dyāvāpṛthivī — heaven and earth (a fixed dual dvandva compound, always used in the dual, 'heaven-and-earth'; gen. dual dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ 'of heaven and earth'; -oḥ + i- → -or i-); idam — this (nom. sg. neut.; joined directly before the vowel a- of antaram, no change); antara — the space between, the interior (nom. sg. neut.; -m before the consonant h- of hi → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.व्याप्तं: vyāptam — vi-āp — to pervade, fill completely (vyāpta: past participle, nom. sg. neut. 'pervaded, filled'; -m before t- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.त्वयैकेन: tvayā ekena — tvam — you (tvayā: instr. sg. 'by you'; -ā + e- → -ai-); eka — one, alone (instr. sg. ekena, agreeing with tvayā: 'by you alone')
glossary.दिशश्च: diśaḥ ca — diś — direction, quarter of the sky (nom. pl. fem.; -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and
glossary.सर्वाः: sarvāḥ — sarva — all (nom. pl. fem., agreeing with diśaḥ)
glossary.दृष्ट्वाद्भुतं: dṛṣṭvā adbhutam — dṛś — to see (dṛṣṭvā: gerund 'having seen'; -ā + a- → -ā-); adbhuta — wonderful, amazing, marvelous (acc. sg. neut.; -m before r- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.रूपमुग्रं: rūpam ugram — rūpa — form, shape (acc. sg. neut.; joined directly before the vowel u- of ugram, no change); ugra — terrible, fierce, awesome (acc. sg. neut.; -m before the consonant t- of tava → anusvāra ṃ; BORI transposes this word with tava idam — see note)
glossary.तवेदं: tava idam — tvam — you (tava: gen. sg. 'your'); idam — this (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with rūpam; -a + i- → -e-; -m before l- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.लोकत्रयं: loka-trayam — loka — world (first member); traya — triad, group of three (loka-traya: 'the three worlds', nom. sg. neut.; -m before p- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.प्रव्यथितं: pravyathitam — pra-vyath — to tremble, be greatly agitated (pravyathita: past participle, nom. sg. neut. 'trembling, agitated'; -m before m- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.महात्मन्: mahātman — mahā — great (first member); ātman — soul, self (mahātman: 'great-souled', vocative sg., addressed to Kṛṣṇa)
glossary.अमी: amī — adas — that, yonder (amī: nom. pl. masc. 'those, these')
glossary.सुरसंघा: sura-saṃghāḥ — sura — a god, deity (first member); saṃgha — host, multitude (sura-saṃgha: 'hosts of gods', nom. pl. masc.; -āḥ before v- → -ā)
glossary.विशन्ति: viśanti — viś — to enter (viśanti: present 3rd pl. 'they enter')
glossary.केचिद्भीताः: kecit bhītāḥ — kim-cit — someone, some (kecit: nom. pl. masc. indefinite; -t + bh- → -d bh-); bhī — to fear (bhīta: past participle 'frightened', nom. pl. masc.; -āḥ + p- → -āḥ, retained before voiceless p-)
glossary.प्राञ्जलयो: prāñjalayaḥ — pra-añjali — with hands folded in reverence (bahuvrīhi, nom. pl. masc. prāñjalayaḥ; -aḥ before g- → -o)
glossary.गृणन्ति: gṛṇanti — gṝ — to call out, utter, proclaim (gṛṇanti: present 3rd pl. 'they cry out')
glossary.स्वस्तीत्युक्त्वा: svasti iti uktvā — svasti — well-being, safety; hail! (exclamation of blessing); iti — thus (closes the quoted exclamation; svasti + iti → -i + i- → -ī-); vac — to speak (uktvā: gerund 'having said'; iti + uktvā → -i + u- → -y u-)
glossary.महर्षिसिद्धसंघाः: mahā-ṛṣi-siddha-saṃghāḥ — mahā — great (first member; -ā + ṛ- → -ar-); ṛṣi — sage, seer (mahā-ṛṣi: 'great sage', second member); siddha — perfected, a perfected being, adept (third member); saṃgha — host, multitude (mahā-ṛṣi-siddha-saṃgha: 'hosts of great sages and perfected beings', nom. pl. masc.)
glossary.स्तुवन्ति: stuvanti — stu — to praise, extol (stuvanti: present 3rd pl. 'they praise')
glossary.स्तुतिभिः: stutibhiḥ — stuti — praise, hymn of praise (instr. pl. 'with praises')
glossary.पुष्कलाभिः: puṣkalābhiḥ — puṣkala — abundant, copious, rich (instr. pl. fem., agreeing with stutibhiḥ)
glossary.रुद्रादित्या: rudra-ādityāḥ — Rudra — Rudra, one of a class of eleven storm-gods (first member; -a + ā- → -ā-); Āditya — Āditya, one of the twelve sons of Aditi, the solar gods (rudra-āditya: 'the Rudras and the Ādityas', nom. pl. masc.; -āḥ before v- → -ā)
glossary.वसवो: vasavaḥ — Vasu — one of the eight Vasus, a class of gods (nom. pl. masc.; -aḥ before y- → -o)
glossary.ये: ye — yad — who, which (ye: nom. pl. masc. relative)
glossary.साध्या: sādhyāḥ — sādhya — a class of minor celestial deities, the Sādhyas (nom. pl. masc.; -āḥ before v- → -ā)
glossary.विश्वेऽश्विनौ: viśve aśvinau — viśva — the Viśvedevas, 'the All-gods', a class of deities (nom. pl. masc. viśve, used substantively as their name); Aśvin — the Aśvins, the twin horsemen-gods, physicians of the gods (nom. dual aśvinau; -e + a- → -e ' with the avagraha marking the lost a-)
glossary.मरुतश्चोष्मपाश्च: marutaḥ ca uṣmapāḥ ca — Marut — a Marut, one of the storm-gods, followers of Indra (nom. pl. marutaḥ; -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and (here fusing with the following vowel u-: -a + u- → -o-); uṣmapa — 'drinker of the (sacrificial) steam', an epithet of the Pitṛs, the ancestral spirits (nom. pl. uṣmapāḥ; -āḥ + c- → -āś c-); ca — and
glossary.गन्धर्वयक्षासुरसिद्धसंघा: gandharva-yakṣa-asura-siddha-saṃghāḥ — gandharva — a gandharva, celestial musician (first member); yakṣa — a yakṣa, semi-divine nature-spirit (second member; -a + a- → -ā- with asura, undone at the hyphen); asura — an asura, demon, anti-god (third member); siddha — a siddha, perfected being (fourth member); saṃgha — host, multitude (gandharva-yakṣa-asura-siddha-saṃgha: 'hosts of gandharvas, yakṣas, asuras and siddhas', nom. pl. masc.; -āḥ before v- → -ā)
glossary.वीक्षन्ते: vīkṣante — vi-īkṣ — to look at, gaze upon (vīkṣante: present middle 3rd pl. 'they gaze at')
glossary.विस्मिताश्चैव: vismitāḥ ca eva — vi-smi — to be astonished, amazed (vismita: past participle, nom. pl. masc.; -āḥ + c- → -āś c-); ca — and; eva — indeed, just (ca + eva → caiva)
glossary.रूपं: rūpam — rūpa — form, shape (acc. sg. neut.; -m before m- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.महत्ते: mahat te — mahat — great, vast (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with rūpam); tvam — you (te: enclitic gen. sg. 'your')
glossary.बहुवक्त्रनेत्रं: bahu-vaktra-netram — bahu — many, much (first member); vaktra — mouth, face (second member); netra — eye (bahu-vaktra-netra: 'having many mouths and eyes', acc. sg. neut., describing rūpam; -m before m- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.महाबाहो: mahā-bāho — mahā — great (first member); bāhu — arm (mahā-bāhu: 'mighty-armed', vocative sg., addressed to Kṛṣṇa)
glossary.बहुबाहूरुपादम्: bahu-bāhu-ūru-pādam — bahu — many (first member); bāhu — arm (second member; -u + ū- → -ū- with ūru, undone at the hyphen); ūru — thigh (third member); pāda — foot (bahu-bāhu-ūru-pāda: 'having many arms, thighs and feet', acc. sg. neut., describing rūpam)
glossary.बहूदरं: bahu-udaram — bahu — many (first member; -u + u- → -ū- with udara, undone at the hyphen); udara — belly (bahu-udara: 'many-bellied', acc. sg. neut., describing rūpam; -m before b- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.बहुदंष्ट्राकरालं: bahu-daṃṣṭrā-karālam — bahu — many (first member); daṃṣṭrā — tusk, fang (second member); karāla — terrible, gaping, fearsome (bahu-daṃṣṭrā-karāla: 'terrible with many gaping fangs', acc. sg. neut., describing rūpam; -m before d- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.दृष्ट्वा: dṛṣṭvā — dṛś — to see (dṛṣṭvā: gerund 'having seen')
glossary.लोकाः: lokāḥ — loka — world, people (nom. pl. masc.)
glossary.प्रव्यथितास्तथाहम्: pravyathitāḥ tathā aham — pra-vyath — to tremble, be agitated (pravyathita: past participle, nom. pl. masc. 'trembling'; -āḥ + t- → -ās t-); tathā — likewise, so too (-ā + a- → -ā-); aham — I (nom. sg., 'I too')
glossary.नभःस्पृशं: nabhaḥ-spṛśam — nabhas — sky (first member; visarga retained as -ḥ before the voiceless s-); spṛś — touching (root-derived adjective from spṛś 'to touch'; nabhaḥ-spṛś: 'sky-touching', acc. sg. masc., describing tvām; -m before d- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.दीप्तमनेकवर्णं: dīptam aneka-varṇam — dīp — to blaze, shine (dīpta: past participle 'blazing', acc. sg. masc., agreeing with tvām; joined directly before the vowel a- of anekavarṇam, no change); aneka — many, various (first member); varṇa — color (aneka-varṇa: 'many-colored', acc. sg. masc.; -m before the consonant v- of the next word → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.व्यात्ताननं: vyātta-ānanam — vi-ā-dā — to open wide (vyātta: past participle 'gaping, wide open', first member; -a + ā- → -ā-); ānana — mouth, face (vyātta-ānana: 'with gaping mouth', acc. sg. masc.; -m before the consonant d- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.दीप्तविशालनेत्रम्: dīpta-viśāla-netram — dīpta — blazing (first member); viśāla — vast, huge, broad (second member); netra — eye (dīpta-viśāla-netra: 'with blazing, huge eyes', acc. sg. masc., agreeing with tvām)
glossary.प्रव्यथितान्तरात्मा: pravyathita-antar-ātmā — pra-vyath — to tremble (pravyathita: past participle, first member; -a + a- → -ā-); antar — within, inner (second member); ātman — soul, self (pravyathita-antar-ātman: 'whose inmost self is trembling', nom. sg. masc., describing the speaker, Arjuna)
glossary.धृतिं: dhṛtim — dhṛti — steadiness, firmness, courage, composure (acc. sg. fem.; -m before n- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.विन्दामि: vindāmi — vid — to find, obtain (class 6 root vid, distinct from vid 'to know'; vindāmi: present 1st sg. 'I find')
glossary.शमं: śamam — śama — peace, calm, tranquility (acc. sg. masc.; -m before c- → anusvāra ṃ)
glossary.विष्णो: viṣṇo — Viṣṇu — Viṣṇu, the proper name here given outright to Kṛṣṇa (vocative sg.)

glossary.कालानलसन्निभानि: kāla-anala-sannibhāni — kāla — time, doomsday; anala — fire (kāla-anala 'the fire of doomsday', -a + a- → -ā-); sannibha — resembling, like (kāla-anala-sannibha 'resembling the fire of doomsday', acc. pl. neut., agreeing with mukhāni)

glossary.देवेश: deva-īśa — deva — god; īśa — lord (deveśa 'lord of gods', vocative; -a + ī- → -e-)

glossary.द्रोणः: droṇaḥ — Droṇa — Droṇa, the teacher (nom. sg.)

glossary.भयानकानि: bhayānakāni — bhayānaka — frightful, terrifying (acc. pl. neut.)
glossary.केचिद्विलग्ना: kecit vilagnāḥ — kim-cit — someone, some (kecit: nom. pl. masc. indefinite; -t + v- → -d v-); vi-lag — to be stuck, caught (vilagna: past participle, nom. pl. masc.; -āḥ before d- → -ā)

glossary.चूर्णितैरुत्तमाङ्गैः: cūrṇitaiḥ uttama-aṅgaiḥ — cūrṇita — crushed, pulverized (instr. pl.; -aiḥ + u- → -air u-); uttama — highest, best; aṅga — limb (uttama-aṅga 'the highest limb', i.e. the head, instr. pl.: 'with their heads crushed'; -a + a- → -ā-)

glossary.तवामी: tava amī — tvam — you (tava: gen. sg. 'your'); adas — that, yonder; here 'these' (amī: nom. pl. masc.; tava + amī → tavāmī, -a + a- → -ā-)
glossary.नरलोकवीरा: nara-loka-vīrāḥ — nara — man; loka — world (nara-loka 'the world of men'); vīra — hero (nara-loka-vīra 'heroes of the human world', nom. pl.; -āḥ before v- → -ā)
glossary.वक्त्राण्यभिविज्वलन्ति: vaktrāṇi abhivijvalanti — vaktra — mouth, face (vaktrāṇi: acc. pl. neut., object of viśanti and subject of abhivijvalanti; -i + a- → -y a-); abhi-vi-jval — to blaze forth exceedingly (abhivijvalanti: present 3rd pl. 'they blaze')
glossary.प्रदीप्तं: pradīptam — pra-dīp — to blaze, flame up (pradīpta: past participle 'blazing', acc. sg. neut.)
glossary.ज्वलनं: jvalanam — jvalana — fire, flame (acc. sg. neut.)
glossary.पतङ्गा: pataṅgāḥ — pataṅga — moth (nom. pl. masc.; -āḥ before v- → -ā)
glossary.नाशाय: nāśāya — nāśa — destruction, ruin (dat. sg. 'for destruction')
glossary.समृद्धवेगाः: samṛddha-vegāḥ — sam-ṛdh — to grow full, thrive (samṛddha: past participle 'grown full, gathered'); vega — speed, momentum (samṛddha-vega 'with gathered speed', nom. pl. masc., agreeing with pataṅgāḥ)

glossary.स्तवापि: s tava api — loka — world; here, the people (s: the leftover of lokāḥ's sandhi -ās before t-, completing the word begun on the previous line — see note); tvam — you (tava: gen. sg. 'your'); api — also, too (tava + api → tavāpi, -a + a- → -ā-)

glossary.तेजोभिरापूर्य: tejobhiḥ āpūrya — tejas — radiance, energy, splendor (instr. pl. 'with your radiances'; -iḥ + ā- → -ir ā-); ā-pṝ — to fill completely (āpūrya: gerund 'having filled')
glossary.जगत्समग्रं: jagat samagram — jagat — world, universe (acc. sg. neut.); samagra — entire, whole (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with jagat)
glossary.भासस्तवोग्राः: bhāsaḥ tava ugrāḥ — bhās — light, radiance, splendor (bhāsaḥ: nom. pl. fem., subject of pratapanti; -aḥ + t- → -as t-); tvam — you (tava: gen. sg. 'your'); ugra — fierce, terrible (ugrāḥ: nom. pl. fem., agreeing with bhāsaḥ; tava + u- → -o-)
glossary.प्रतपन्ति: pratapanti — pra-tap — to blaze, scorch, burn fiercely (pratapanti: present 3rd pl.)
glossary.आख्याहि: ākhyāhi — ā-khyā — to declare, tell (ākhyāhi: imperative 2nd sg. 'tell!')
glossary.को: kaḥ — kim — who? (kaḥ: nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ before bh- → -o)
glossary.भवानुग्ररूपो: bhavān ugra-rūpaḥ — bhavat — your honour, you (bhavān: nom. sg. respectful); ugra — fierce, terrible; rūpa — form (ugra-rūpa 'of fierce form', nom. sg., agreeing with bhavān; -aḥ before n- → -o)
glossary.नमोऽस्तु: namaḥ astu — namas — homage, obeisance (nom. sg. neut.; -aḥ + a- → -o ' with avagraha); as — to be (astu: imperative 3rd sg. 'let it be')
glossary.देववर: deva-vara — deva — god; vara — best, most excellent (deva-vara 'best of gods', vocative)
glossary.विज्ञातुमिच्छामि: vijñātum icchāmi — vi-jñā — to know fully, understand (vijñātum: infinitive 'to know'); iṣ — to wish (icchāmi: present 1st sg. 'I wish')
glossary.भवन्तमाद्यं: bhavantam ādyam — bhavat — your honour, you (bhavantam: acc. sg.); ādya — primal, original, the first (acc. sg., agreeing with bhavantam)
glossary.प्रजानामि: prajānāmi — pra-jñā — to understand, comprehend (prajānāmi: present 1st sg. 'I understand')
glossary.प्रवृत्तिम्: pravṛttim — pra-vṛtti — activity, function, course, mode of action or being (acc. sg.)
glossary.कालोऽस्मि: kālaḥ asmi — kāla — time, the power that measures and ends all things (nom. sg.; -aḥ + a- → -o ' with avagraha); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg. 'I am')
glossary.लोकक्षयकृत्प्रवृद्धो: loka-kṣaya-kṛt pravṛddhaḥ — loka — world; kṣaya — destruction (loka-kṣaya 'the destruction of the worlds'); kṛt — maker, doer (agent-noun suffix; loka-kṣaya-kṛt 'maker of world-destruction, world-destroyer', nom. sg., in apposition to kālaḥ); pra-vṛdh — to grow, become great (pravṛddha: past participle 'grown great, vastly increased', nom. sg., in apposition to kālaḥ; -aḥ before l- → -o)
glossary.लोकान्समाहर्तुमिह: lokān samāhartum iha — loka — world (lokān: acc. pl., object of samāhartum); sam-ā-hṛ — to gather in, carry off (samāhartum: infinitive 'to gather in'); iha — here
glossary.प्रवृत्तः: pravṛttaḥ — pra-vṛt — to be set in motion, be engaged, be at work (pravṛtta: past participle 'set in motion, at work', nom. sg., in apposition to kālaḥ)
glossary.ऋतेऽपि: ṛte api — ṛte — without, except (indeclinable, governing the accusative tvām); api — even (-e + a- → -e ' with avagraha)
glossary.भविष्यन्ति: bhaviṣyanti — bhū — to be, exist (bhaviṣyanti: future 3rd pl. 'they will be')
glossary.येऽवस्थिताः: ye avasthitāḥ — yad — who (ye: nom. pl. masc. relative; -e + a- → -e ' with avagraha); ava-sthā — to stand, be positioned (avasthita: past participle 'stationed, arrayed', nom. pl.)
glossary.प्रत्यनीकेषु: prati-anīkeṣu — prati — against, opposing (prefix); anīka — battle-line, array (prati-anīka 'the opposing ranks', loc. pl.; -i + a- → -y a-)
glossary.तस्मात्त्वमुत्तिष्ठ: tasmāt tvam uttiṣṭha — tad — that (tasmāt: abl. sg. 'therefore'); tvam — you (nom. sg.; tasmāt + tvam written doubled, -t + t- → -tt-); ud-sthā — to rise up, stand (uttiṣṭha: imperative 2nd sg. 'arise!')
glossary.यशो: yaśaḥ — yaśas — fame, glory (acc. sg. neut.; -aḥ before l- → -o)
glossary.लभस्व: labhasva — labh — to obtain, win (labhasva: imperative middle 2nd sg. 'win!')
glossary.जित्वा: jitvā — ji — to conquer (jitvā: gerund 'having conquered')
glossary.भुङ्क्ष्व: bhuṅkṣva — bhuj — to enjoy (bhuṅkṣva: imperative middle 2nd sg. 'enjoy!')
glossary.समृद्धम्: samṛddham — sam-ṛdh — to grow full, flourish (samṛddha: past participle 'prosperous, flourishing', acc. sg., agreeing with rājyam)
glossary.मयैवैते: mayā eva ete — aham — I (mayā: instr. sg. 'by me'); eva — indeed, just (mayā + eva → mayaiva, -ā + e- → -ai-); etad — this (ete: nom. pl. masc. 'these', referring to the warriors; eva + ete → evaite, -a + e- → -ai-)
glossary.निहताः: nihatāḥ — ni-han — to strike down, slay (nihata: past participle 'slain', nom. pl.)
glossary.पूर्वमेव: pūrvam eva — pūrva — before, first (pūrvam: adverbial acc. 'already, beforehand'); eva — indeed
glossary.निमित्तमात्रं: nimitta-mātram — nimitta — cause, occasion, instrument; mātra — mere, only (nimitta-mātra 'a mere instrument', acc. sg. neut., predicate)
glossary.भव: bhava — bhū — to be, become (bhava: imperative 2nd sg. 'be!')
glossary.सव्यसाचिन्: savyasācin — savya-sācin — 'able also with the left hand', the ambidextrous archer, an epithet of Arjuna (vocative sg.)
glossary.द्रोणं: droṇam — Droṇa — Droṇa, the teacher (acc. sg.)
glossary.जयद्रथं: jayadratham — Jayadratha — Jayadratha, king of Sindhu, ally of the Kauravas (acc. sg.)
glossary.कर्णं: karṇam — Karṇa — Karṇa, Kuntī's secret first-born, fighting for the Kauravas (acc. sg.)
glossary.तथान्यानपि: tathā anyān api — tathā — likewise (tathā + anyān → tathānyān, -ā + a- → -ā-); anya — other (anyān: acc. pl. masc.); api — even, also
glossary.योधवीरान्: yodha-vīrān — yodha — warrior; vīra — hero (yodha-vīra 'warrior-hero', acc. pl., in apposition to anyān: 'other warrior-heroes')
glossary.हतांस्त्वं: hatān tvam — han — to kill (hata: past participle 'slain', hatān: acc. pl. masc., in apposition to the named warriors; -n + t- → -ṃs t-); tvam — you (nom. sg.)
glossary.जहि: jahi — han — to kill, strike (jahi: imperative 2nd sg. 'kill!')
glossary.मा: mā — mā — do not (prohibitive particle, with the aorist injunctive)
glossary.व्यथिष्ठा: vyathiṣṭhāḥ — vyath — to waver, tremble, be distressed (vyathiṣṭhāḥ: aorist injunctive 2nd sg. 'do not waver, do not be troubled'; -āḥ before y- → -ā)
glossary.युध्यस्व: yudhyasva — yudh — to fight (yudhyasva: imperative middle 2nd sg. 'fight!')
glossary.जेतासि: jetā asi — ji — to conquer (jetṛ: agent noun 'conqueror, victor', jetā: nom. sg.); as — to be (asi: present 2nd sg. 'you are'; jetā + asi → jetāsi, -ā + a- → -ā-)
glossary.सपत्नान्: sapatnān — sapatna — rival, enemy, foe (acc. pl.)
glossary.एतच्छ्रुत्वा: etat śrutvā — etad — this (etat: acc. sg. neut., object of śrutvā; -t + ś- → -c ch-); śru — to hear (śrutvā: gerund 'having heard')
glossary.वचनं: vacanam — vacana — word, speech (acc. sg. neut., 'this word', object of śrutvā)
glossary.केशवस्य: keśavasya — Keśava — 'having fine hair' or 'slayer of the demon Keśin', an epithet of Kṛṣṇa (gen. sg. 'of Keśava')
glossary.कृताञ्जलिर्वेपमानः: kṛta-añjaliḥ vepamānaḥ — kṛta — done, made (past participle of kṛ; first compound member); añjali — the gesture of cupped, folded hands raised in reverence (kṛta-añjali: 'one who has made the añjali', i.e. 'with hands folded in homage', nom. sg. masc.; -iḥ + v- → -ir v-); vip/vep — to tremble, quake (vepamāna: present middle participle 'trembling', nom. sg. masc.)
glossary.किरीटी: kirīṭī — kirīṭin — crowned, wearing a diadem; an epithet of Arjuna, from the diadem given him by Indra (nom. sg. masc.)
glossary.नमस्कृत्वा: namas-kṛtvā — namas — homage, obeisance (first member of the compound verb namas-kṛ, 'to do homage to, bow to'); kṛ — to do, make (kṛtvā: gerund 'having done'; namaskṛtvā: 'having bowed down')
glossary.भूय: bhūyaḥ — bhūyas — more, again, once more (used adverbially; bhūyaḥ: 'again'; -aḥ dropped before the vowel e- of eva that follows — unlike before a-, a final -aḥ before any other vowel is simply lost, with no avagraha)
glossary.एवाह: eva āha — eva — indeed, just (adverb); ah — to say (āha: perfect 3rd sg. 'he said'; eva + āha: a + ā → ā)
glossary.कृष्णं: kṛṣṇam — Kṛṣṇa — Kṛṣṇa, the divine speaker of the Gītā, Arjuna's charioteer and friend (acc. sg., addressed: 'spoke to Kṛṣṇa')
glossary.सगद्गदं: sa-gadgadam — sa — with, possessing (prefix); gadgada — stammering, faltering, choked with emotion (sa-gadgada: 'with a broken voice', acc. sg. neut., adverbial: 'brokenly, in a choked voice')
glossary.भीतभीतः: bhīta-bhītaḥ — bhī — to fear (bhīta: past participle 'afraid', doubled for intensity, bhīta-bhīta: 'frightened again and again, utterly afraid', nom. sg. masc.)
glossary.स्थाने: sthāne — sthāna — place; used adverbially (loc. sg. sthāne: 'fittingly, rightly, it is fitting that...', an idiom, not a literal 'in the place')
glossary.हृषीकेश: hṛṣīkeśa — Hṛṣīkeśa — 'lord of the senses', Kṛṣṇa (vocative sg.)
glossary.प्रकीर्त्या: prakīrtyā — pra-kīrti — praise, glory, fame, proclamation (instr. sg. 'at the proclamation of, at the renown of')
glossary.जगत्प्रहृष्यत्यनुरज्यते: jagat prahṛṣyati anurajyate — jagat — the world (nom. sg. neut., subject; -t + p- → -t p-, simply written joined, no phonetic change); pra-hṛṣ — to thrill, rejoice, be delighted (prahṛṣyati: present 3rd sg. 'rejoices'); anu-rañj — to be delighted, become attached to, feel affection for (anurajyate: present middle 3rd sg. 'becomes delighted, is filled with love'; -i + a- → -y a-)
glossary.रक्षांसि: rakṣāṃsi — rakṣas — a demon, a rākṣasa (nom. pl. neut., subject)
glossary.भीतानि: bhītāni — bhī — to fear (bhīta: past participle 'afraid, frightened', nom. pl. neut.)
glossary.नमस्यन्ति: namasyanti — namasya — to bow to, pay homage to (denominative from namas; present 3rd pl.)
glossary.सिद्धसंघाः: siddha-saṃghāḥ — siddha — perfected, accomplished; a class of semi-divine beings of supernatural power (first compound member); saṃgha — host, multitude, assembly (siddha-saṃgha: 'hosts of siddhas', nom. pl. masc., subject)
glossary.कस्माच्च: kasmāt ca — kim — what? (kasmāt: abl. sg. 'for what reason, why'); ca — and, also (-t + c- → -c c-)
glossary.नमेरन्महात्मन्: nameran mahātman — nam — to bow, do reverence (nameran: optative 3rd pl. 'they would/should bow'); mahātman — great-souled, high-souled (an address, vocative: 'O great one', to Kṛṣṇa; written joined with nameran, no phonetic change)
glossary.गरीयसे: garīyase — garīyas — greater, weightier, more venerable (comparative of guru; dat. sg. masc., in apposition to an implied 'to you': 'to the greater one')
glossary.ब्रह्मणोऽप्यादिकर्त्रे: brahmaṇaḥ api ādi-kartre — Brahmā — Brahmā, the creator-god of the traditional cosmology (a proper name — see note; brahmaṇaḥ: abl. sg., ablative of comparison with garīyase, 'greater than Brahmā'; -aḥ + a- → -o ' with avagraha); api — even, also (-i + ā- → -y ā-); ādi-kartṛ — the original maker, the first creator (ādi 'beginning, first' + kartṛ 'maker, doer'; dat. sg., in apposition: 'to the original creator')
glossary.अनन्त: ananta — ananta — endless, infinite (vocative sg., an epithet: 'O endless one')
glossary.सदसत्तत्परं: sat asat tat-param — sat — being, the existent (nom. sg. neut., predicate; -t + a- → -d a-); asat — non-being, the non-existent (nom. sg. neut., predicate; -t + t- → -t t-, written doubled); tad — that (tat: nom. sg. neut., correlative with the following yat); para — supreme, highest (tat-param: 'what is beyond that', nom. sg. neut., predicate)
glossary.यत्: yat — yad — which, that which (yat: nom. sg. neut. relative pronoun, tying the predication together)
glossary.त्वमादिदेवः: tvam ādi-devaḥ — tvam — you (nom. sg., subject); ādi-deva — the primal god, the first god (ādi 'beginning, first' + deva 'god'; nom. sg., predicate)
glossary.पुरुषः: puruṣaḥ — puruṣa — the Person, the Spirit; in the Sāṃkhya scheme the conscious self set against nature (prakṛti), here used of Kṛṣṇa as the cosmic Person underlying the universe (nom. sg., predicate)
glossary.पुराण-: purāṇa- — purāṇa — ancient, primal, of old (nom. sg. masc., predicate: 'you are the ancient one'; its visarga -aḥ combines with the following tvam — the Wikisource print breaks this word across the pāda; see note)
glossary.स्त्वमस्य: s tvam asya — purāṇa — ancient, primal (s: the final consonant of purāṇaḥ, its visarga turned to -s- before the following t-, completing the word begun on the previous printed line — see note); tvam — you (nom. sg., subject, resuming the predication of line 1); idam — this (asya: gen. sg. neut., 'of this', i.e. of the universe)
glossary.वेत्तासि: vettā asi — vid — to know (vettṛ: agent noun 'knower'; vettā: nom. sg., predicate); as — to be (asi: present 2nd sg. 'you are'; vettā + asi: ā + a → ā)
glossary.वेद्यं: vedyam — vid — to know (vedya: gerundive 'to be known, the knowable', nom. sg. neut., predicate)
glossary.धाम: dhāma — dhāman — abode, state, seat, glory (nom. sg. neut., predicate: 'the supreme abode, the highest state')
glossary.त्वया: tvayā — tvam — you (tvayā: instr. sg. 'by you')
glossary.ततं: tatam — tan — to stretch, extend, pervade (tata: past participle 'pervaded, extended', nom. sg. neut., predicate, agreeing with viśvam)
glossary.विश्वमनन्तरूप: viśvam ananta-rūpa — viśva — universe, all (viśvam: nom. sg. neut., subject); ananta — endless, infinite (first compound member); rūpa — form (ananta-rūpa: 'of endless form, having infinite forms', vocative sg., addressing Kṛṣṇa: 'O one of infinite form')
glossary.वायुर्यमोऽग्निर्वरुणः: vāyuḥ yamaḥ agniḥ varuṇaḥ — Vāyu — Vāyu, the wind-god (nom. sg., predicate; -uḥ + y- → -ur y-); Yama — Yama, god of death (nom. sg., predicate; -aḥ + a- → -o ' with avagraha); Agni — Agni, the fire-god (nom. sg., predicate; -iḥ + v- → -ir v-); Varuṇa — Varuṇa, god of the waters and of cosmic order (nom. sg., predicate)
glossary.शशाङ्कः: śaśāṅkaḥ — śaśāṅka — the moon, literally 'hare-marked' (śaśa 'hare' + aṅka 'mark', from the mark on the moon's face; nom. sg., predicate)
glossary.प्रजापतिस्त्वं: prajāpatiḥ tvam — Prajāpati — Prajāpati, 'lord of creatures', a creator-deity (nom. sg., predicate; -iḥ + t- → -is t-, visarga before a voiceless consonant); tvam — you (nom. sg., subject)
glossary.प्रपितामहश्च: pra-pitāmahaḥ ca — pra-pitāmaha — the great-grandfather, one step beyond even Brahmā the grandfather-creator named in the previous verse (pitāmaha 'grandfather' with the intensive prefix pra-; nom. sg., predicate; -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and
glossary.नमो: namaḥ — namas — homage, obeisance (nom./acc. sg. neut., exclamatory: 'homage!'; -aḥ before n- → -o)
glossary.नमस्तेऽस्तु: namaḥ te astu — namas — homage, obeisance (namaḥ: -aḥ + t- → -as t-); tvam — you (te: enclitic dat. sg. 'to you'); as — to be (astu: imperative 3rd sg. 'let there be'; te + astu: -e + a- → -e ' with avagraha)
glossary.सहस्रकृत्वः: sahasra-kṛtvaḥ — sahasra — a thousand (first compound member); kṛtvas — times (multiplicative numeral suffix; sahasra-kṛtvas: 'a thousand times', adverbial)
glossary.पुनश्च: punaḥ ca — punar — again (punaḥ: -aḥ + c- → -aś c-); ca — and
glossary.भूयोऽपि: bhūyaḥ api — bhūyas — more, again, further (bhūyaḥ: adverbial 'yet again'; -aḥ + a- → -o ' with avagraha)
glossary.नमस्ते: namaḥ te — namas — homage, obeisance (namaḥ: -aḥ + t- → -as t-); tvam — you (te: enclitic dat. sg. 'to you')
glossary.नमः: namaḥ — namas — homage, obeisance (nom./acc. sg. neut.)
glossary.पुरस्तादथ: purastāt atha — purastāt — in front, before, from the front (indeclinable; -t + a- → -d a-); atha — then, and, also
glossary.पृष्ठतस्ते: pṛṣṭhataḥ te — pṛṣṭhatas — from behind, at the back (indeclinable; -aḥ + t- → -as t-); tvam — you (te: enclitic dat. sg. 'to you')
glossary.सर्वत: sarvataḥ — sarvatas — from everywhere, from every side, on all sides (indeclinable; -aḥ dropped before the vowel e- of eva, as at verse 35's bhūya eva)
glossary.सर्व: sarva — sarva — all; here vocative, an epithet: 'O you who are all, O universal one'
glossary.अनन्तवीर्यामितविक्रमस्त्वं: ananta-vīrya-amita-vikramaḥ tvam — ananta — endless (first compound member); vīrya — power, might, valor, prowess (second member; ananta-vīrya: 'of endless might'); amita — immeasurable, unlimited (third member; vīrya + amita: a + a → ā); vikrama — prowess, valor, might (ananta-vīrya-amita-vikrama: 'of endless might and immeasurable prowess', nom. sg. masc., predicate; -aḥ + t- → -as t-); tvam — you (nom. sg., subject)
glossary.सर्वं: sarvam — sarva — all, everything (acc. sg. neut., object of samāpnoṣi)
glossary.समाप्नोषि: samāpnoṣi — sam-āp — to attain fully, pervade, comprehend completely (samāpnoṣi: present 2nd sg. 'you pervade, you encompass')
glossary.ततोऽसि: tataḥ asi — tatas — therefore, hence (tataḥ: -aḥ + a- → -o ' with avagraha); as — to be (asi: present 2nd sg. 'you are')
glossary.सर्वः: sarvaḥ — sarva — all (nom. sg. masc., predicate: 'you are the All')
glossary.सखेति: sakhā iti — sakhi — friend (sakhā: nom. sg., used as an exclamation of address, 'a friend!'; -ā + i- fuse to -e-); iti — thus, so (quote-marker closing a reported thought or speech)
glossary.मत्वा: matvā — man — to think, consider (matvā: gerund, 'having thought, considering')
glossary.प्रसभं: prasabham — prasabham — forcibly, violently, presumptuously (adverbial acc. sg. neut. of prasabha)
glossary.यदुक्तं: yat uktam — yat — which, what (relative pronoun, nom./acc. sg. neut., correlated with tat in the next verse); vac — to speak (uktam: past participle 'said'; -t + u- → -d u-, written joined as yaduktam)
glossary.यादव: yādava — Yādava — descendant of Yadu, an epithet of Kṛṣṇa (vocative sg.)
glossary.अजानता: ajānatā — a-jñā — not to know (ajānatā: present participle, instr. sg. masc., 'by [me] not knowing', agreeing with mayā in the next line)
glossary.महिमानं: mahimānam — mahiman — greatness (acc. sg., object of ajānatā)
glossary.प्रमादात्प्रणयेन: pramādāt praṇayena — pramāda — carelessness, negligence, error (pramādāt: abl. sg. 'out of carelessness'); praṇaya — affection, love (praṇayena: instr. sg. 'out of affection'; written joined with pramādāt though no sound change occurs, -t + p- unchanged)
glossary.वापि: vā api — vā — or (disjunctive particle); api — even, also (emphatic particle; vā + api → -ā + a- → -ā-, the short a of api elided)
glossary.यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि: yat ca avahāsa-artham asatkṛtaḥ asi — yat — which, what (relative pronoun, picking up alongside yad uktam of the previous verse; -t + c- → -c c-, written yacca); ca — and; avahāsa — mockery, joking, ridicule (avahāsa-artham: 'for the sake of a joke', first compound member; -a + a- → -ā-, written joined); artha — purpose, sake (avahāsārtham: acc. sg. neut. used adverbially, second compound member; written joined with the following word, -m + a- unchanged); a-sat-kṛta — treated improperly, disrespected (asatkṛtaḥ: past participle, nom. sg. masc., 'you were treated with disrespect'; -aḥ + a- → -o-, the following a- elided, marked by avagraha); as — to be (asi: present 2nd sg. 'you are')
glossary.विहारशय्यासनभोजनेषु: vihāra-śayyā-āsana-bhojaneṣu — vihāra — sport, recreation, play (first compound member); śayyā — bed, lying down, resting (second compound member); āsana — seat, sitting (third compound member; śayyā + āsana → -ā + ā- → -ā-, written joined); bhojana — eating, a meal (compound bhojaneṣu: loc. pl., 'in play, in resting, in sitting, or in eating')
glossary.एकोऽथवाप्यच्युत: ekaḥ athavā api acyuta — eka — one, alone (nom. sg. masc., 'alone', describing the circumstance — whether private or in company); athavā — or else, or (disjunctive particle; -aḥ + a- → -o-, elided a marked by avagraha); api — even, also (emphatic particle; athavā + api → -ā + a- → -ā-); Acyuta — 'the Unfallen', an epithet of Kṛṣṇa (vocative sg.; api + a- → apy a-, the i of api becomes y before the following vowel)
glossary.तत्समक्षं: tat samakṣam — tad — that (acc. sg. neut., resuming yad uktam and yac...asi); samakṣam — in [one's] presence, openly, before the eyes (adverbial acc.; written joined with tat, -t + s- unchanged)
glossary.तत्क्षामये: tat kṣāmaye — tad — that (acc. sg. neut., object of kṣāmaye, resuming all that was said above); kṣam — to forgive, be patient (kṣāmaye: causative present 1st sg. middle, 'I beg pardon for, I ask to be forgiven')
glossary.त्वामहमप्रमेयम्: tvām aham aprameyam — tvam — you (tvām: acc. sg., object of kṣāmaye); aham — I (aham: nom. sg. subject; tvām + aham written joined, -m + a- unchanged); a-prameya — immeasurable, unfathomable (aprameyam: acc. sg. masc., agreeing with tvām, 'you the immeasurable')
glossary.पितासि: pitā asi — pitṛ — father (pitā: nom. sg., 'you are the father'; pitā + asi → -ā + a- → -ā-, elided); as — to be (asi: present 2nd sg. 'you are')
glossary.लोकस्य: lokasya — loka — world (gen. sg. 'of the world')
glossary.चराचरस्य: cara-acarasya — cara — moving, animate (first compound member); acara — unmoving, inanimate (cara-acarasya: gen. sg., 'of the moving and the unmoving'; -a + a- → -ā-, written caracarasya)
glossary.पूज्यश्च: pūjyaḥ ca — pūj — to honor, revere (pūjya: gerundive, nom. sg. masc., 'worthy of honor, to be revered'; -aḥ + c- → -aś c-)
glossary.गुरुर्गरीयान्: guruḥ garīyān — guru — teacher, one to be revered (nom. sg.; -aḥ + g- → -ar g-); garīyas — weightier, more venerable, greater (comparative of guru; nom. sg. masc.)
glossary.त्वत्समोऽस्त्यभ्यधिकः: tvat-samaḥ asti abhyadhikaḥ — tvad — you (tvat: abl. sg. used in a compound, 'than you'); sama — equal (tvat-sama: 'equal to you', nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ + a- → -o-, elided a marked by avagraha); as — to be, exist (asti: present 3rd sg. 'there is'; tvatsamaḥ + asti → tvatsamo'sti, as above); abhy-adhika — surpassing, superior (abhyadhikaḥ: nom. sg. masc.; asti + abhyadhikaḥ → -i + a- → -y a-, written asty abhyadhikaḥ)
glossary.कुतोऽन्यो: kutaḥ anyaḥ — kutas — whence, how (interrogative adverb); anya — other, another (anyaḥ: nom. sg. masc., 'another [one]'; kutaḥ + anyaḥ → -aḥ + a- → -o-, elided a marked by avagraha; the resulting anyaḥ then shows -aḥ → -o before the voiced l- of lokatraye in the next line, a visarga sandhi carried across the pāda break)
glossary.लोकत्रयेऽप्यप्रतिमप्रभाव: loka-traye api a-pratima-prabhāva — loka — world (first compound member); traya — triad, three (loka-traya: 'the three worlds', loc. sg. loka-traye, 'in the three worlds'); api — even, also (emphatic particle; -e + a- → -e-, elided a marked by avagraha); a-pratima — unequalled, without compare (first member of the vocative compound; api + a- → apy a-, glide as above); prabhāva — power, might, majesty (a-pratima-prabhāva: 'whose majesty is unequalled', vocative sg. masc., addressing Kṛṣṇa)
glossary.तस्मात्प्रणम्य: tasmāt praṇamya — tasmāt — therefore, for that reason (ablative used adverbially); pra-nam — to bow down, prostrate oneself (praṇamya: gerund, 'having bowed down'; written joined with tasmāt, -t + p- unchanged)
glossary.प्रणिधाय: praṇidhāya — pra-ni-dhā — to place down, fix, prostrate (praṇidhāya: gerund, 'having bowed, having prostrated')
glossary.कायं: kāyam — kāya — body (acc. sg., object of praṇamya/praṇidhāya)
glossary.प्रसादये: prasādaye — pra-sad — to become calm, gracious (prasādaye: causative present 1st sg. middle, 'I seek to propitiate, I beg the favor of')
glossary.त्वामहमीशमीड्यम्: tvām aham īśam īḍyam — tvad — you (tvām: acc. sg., object of prasādaye); aham — I (aham: nom. sg. subject; tvām + aham written joined, -m + a- unchanged); īśa — lord, ruler (īśam: acc. sg., in apposition to tvām, 'you the lord'; aham + īśam written joined, -m + ī- unchanged); īḍya — praiseworthy, worthy of adoration (gerundive of īḍ 'to praise'; īḍyam: acc. sg., in apposition to tvām; īśam + īḍyam written joined, -m + ī- unchanged)
glossary.पितेव: pitā iva — pitṛ — father (pitā: nom. sg.; pitā + iva → -ā + i- → -e-); iva — like, as (comparative particle)
glossary.पुत्रस्य: putrasya — putra — son (gen. sg., 'of a son')
glossary.सखेव: sakhā iva — sakhi — friend (sakhā: nom. sg.; sakhā + iva → -ā + i- → -e-, cf. pitā + iva above); iva — like, as (comparative particle)
glossary.सख्युः: sakhyuḥ — sakhi — friend (sakhyuḥ: gen. sg., 'of a friend')
glossary.प्रियः: priyaḥ — priya — dear, beloved (priyaḥ: nom. sg. masc., 'the loving one', subject of arhasi)
glossary.प्रियायार्हसि: priyāyāḥ arhasi — priyā — the beloved, a dear one (f.) (priyāyāḥ: gen. sg. fem., 'of the beloved', continuing the series pitā...putrasya, sakhā...sakhyuḥ); arh — to deserve, ought, be worthy (arhasi: present 2nd sg. 'you ought, you should'; priyāyāḥ + arhasi → -āḥ + a- → -ā-, the visarga drops before the vowel since the preceding vowel is long ā)
glossary.सोढुम्: soḍhum — sah — to bear, endure, put up with (soḍhum: infinitive, 'to bear, to endure', complement of arhasi)
glossary.अदृष्टपूर्वं: a-dṛṣṭa-pūrvam — a-dṛṣṭa — unseen, not seen (first compound member; negative prefix a- + dṛṣṭa, past participle of dṛś 'to see'); pūrva — former, previous (a-dṛṣṭa-pūrvam: 'never seen before', acc. sg. neut., object of dṛṣṭvā)
glossary.हृषितोऽस्मि: hṛṣitaḥ asmi — hṛṣ — to thrill, be delighted, bristle with joy (hṛṣitaḥ: past participle, nom. sg. masc., 'delighted, thrilled'); as — to be (asmi: present 1st sg. 'I am'; hṛṣitaḥ + asmi → -aḥ + a- → -o-, elided a marked by avagraha)
glossary.मनो: manaḥ — manas — mind, heart (nom. sg. neut., subject; -aḥ + m- → -o, visarga sandhi before a voiced consonant)
glossary.तदेव: tat eva — tad — that (acc. sg. neut., object of darśaya, referring to the four-armed form named in the next verse); eva — indeed, just, very (tat + eva: -t + e- → -d e-, voicing of the final consonant before a vowel)
glossary.दर्शय: darśaya — dṛś — to see (darśaya: causative imperative 2nd sg., 'show!')
glossary.चक्रहस्त-: cakra-hasta- — cakra — disc, discus (first compound member); hasta — hand (cakra-hasta: 'having the disc in hand', bahuvrīhi compound describing the form Arjuna wishes to see; the Wikisource print line breaks this compound across the pāda — see note)
glossary.मिच्छामि: m icchāmi — hasta — hand (m: the final -m of hastam, completing cakra-hastam begun on the previous print line — see note); iṣ — to wish, desire (icchāmi: present 1st sg. 'I wish, I desire')
glossary.द्रष्टुमहं: draṣṭum aham — dṛś — to see (draṣṭum: infinitive, 'to see', complement of icchāmi); aham — I (aham: nom. sg. subject of icchāmi; draṣṭum + aham written joined, -m + a- unchanged, the m appearing as anusvāra before the following consonant t- of tathaiva)
glossary.तेनैव: tena eva — tad — that (tena: instr. sg. masc., 'with that', referring to rūpeṇa); eva — indeed, just, very (tena + eva: -a + e- → -ai-, cf. tathā + eva above)
glossary.रूपेण: rūpeṇa — rūpa — form (instr. sg., 'with the ... form')
glossary.चतुर्भुजेन: catur-bhujena — catur — four (first compound member); bhuja — arm (catur-bhuja: 'four-armed', instr. sg. masc., agreeing with rūpeṇa)
glossary.सहस्रबाहो: sahasra-bāho — sahasra — thousand (first compound member); bāhu — arm (sahasra-bāhu: 'thousand-armed', vocative sg., 'O thousand-armed one')
glossary.विश्वमूर्ते: viśva-mūrte — viśva — universe, all (first compound member); mūrti — form, embodiment, shape (viśva-mūrti: 'universal form, whose form is the universe', vocative sg., 'O universal-formed one')
glossary.प्रसन्नेन: prasannena — prasanna — pleased, gracious, favorably disposed (past participle of pra-sad; instr. sg. masc., agreeing with mayā)
glossary.तवार्जुनेदं: tava arjuna idam — tvam — you (tava: gen. sg. 'your'); Arjuna — Arjuna, the Pāṇḍava prince Kṛṣṇa is addressing throughout this chapter (vocative 'O Arjuna'; tava + arjuna: a + a → ā); idam — this (nom./acc. sg. neut., referring to rūpam in the next line; arjuna + idam: a + i → e)
glossary.दर्शितमात्मयोगात्: darśitam ātma-yogāt — dṛś — to see (darśita: causative past participle 'shown, displayed', acc. sg. neut., agreeing with rūpam); ātman — self, own (first compound member); yoga — here 'power, capacity', not the disciplined path named elsewhere (ātma-yoga: 'one's own [supernatural] power', abl. sg. 'through my own power'; darśitam + ātma-yogāt: -m before the vowel ā- simply written joined, no phonetic change)
glossary.तेजोमयं: tejomayam — tejas — splendor, radiance, fiery energy (first compound member; -as + m- → -o m-, visarga sandhi of an -as-stem before a voiced consonant); maya — consisting of, made of (tejo-maya: 'consisting of splendor, blazing', acc. sg. neut., agreeing with rūpam)
glossary.विश्वमनन्तमाद्यं: viśvam anantam ādyam — viśva — universe, all (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with rūpam); ananta — endless, infinite (acc. sg. neut.; viśvam + anantam: -m before the vowel a- simply written joined, no phonetic change); ādya — primal, original, first (acc. sg. neut.; anantam + ādyam: -m before the vowel ā- simply written joined, no phonetic change)
glossary.यन्मे: yat me — yad — which, that (yat: nom./acc. sg. neut. relative, referring back to rūpam; -t + m- → -n m-, assimilation); aham — I (me: gen. sg. enclitic 'of mine')
glossary.त्वदन्येन: tvad anyena — tvad — you (compound stem form of tvam, used in compounds, 'other than you'); anya — other (anyena: instr. sg. masc., agreeing with an unexpressed agent, 'by one other than you'; tvat + anyena: -t + a- → -d a-, voicing before a vowel)
glossary.दृष्टपूर्वम्: dṛṣṭa-pūrvam — dṛś — to see (dṛṣṭa: past participle 'seen', first compound member); pūrva — before, previously (dṛṣṭa-pūrva: 'seen before', nom./acc. sg. neut., predicate agreeing with yat: 'has [never] been seen before')
glossary.वेदयज्ञाध्ययनैर्न: veda-yajña-adhyayanaiḥ na — veda — the Veda, Vedic scripture (first compound member); yajña — sacrifice (second member); adhyayana — study, learning (veda-yajña-adhyayana: 'the study of the Vedas and [performance of] sacrifice', instr. pl. 'by Vedic study and sacrifice'; -aiḥ + n- → -air n-, visarga sandhi before a voiced consonant); na — not (repeated before each item in the list)
glossary.दानै-: dānai- — dāna — gift, gift-giving (dānaiḥ: instr. pl. 'by gifts'; the Wikisource print breaks the pāda here, carrying the -r- that its visarga becomes before the voiced n- of na to the head of the next line — see note)
glossary.र्न: r na — dāna — gift (r: the leftover consonant of dānaiḥ's sandhi before the voiced n- of na, -aiḥ + n- → -air n- [visarga turning to r], completing dānair begun on the previous line — see note); na — not
glossary.क्रियाभिर्न: kriyābhiḥ na — kriyā — rite, ritual act (kriyābhiḥ: instr. pl.; -iḥ + n- → -ir n-, visarga sandhi before a voiced consonant, the same pattern as vedayajñādhyayanaiḥ na above); na — not
glossary.तपोभिरुग्रैः: tapobhiḥ ugraiḥ — tapas — austerity (tapobhiḥ: instr. pl.; -as + bh- → -o bh-, the same -as-stem visarga sandhi as tejomayam in v.47); ugra — fierce, severe (instr. pl., agreeing with tapobhiḥ; -iḥ + u- → -ir u-, visarga before a vowel)
glossary.एवंरूपः: evaṃrūpaḥ — evam — thus, such (first compound member); rūpa — form (evaṃ-rūpa: 'of this form, of such a kind', nom. sg. masc., predicate)
glossary.शक्य: śakyaḥ — śakya — possible, able to be done (gerundive of śak; nom. sg. masc., agreeing with the understood aham, 'I am able'; the expected visarga before the following vowel a- is simply dropped here, without the usual guṇa to -o — an epic-Sanskrit metrical variant, not the regular rule; contrast evaṃvidho 'rjuna in v.54 just below, and samo 'ham at 9.29, where the regular rule applies)
glossary.नृलोके: nṛ-loke — nṛ — man (first compound member); loka — world (nṛ-loka: 'the world of men', loc. sg.)
glossary.द्रष्टुं: draṣṭum — dṛś — to see (draṣṭum: infinitive, here in a passive sense 'to be seen', completing śakyaḥ)
glossary.कुरुप्रवीर: kuru-pravīra — Kuru — the Kuru clan (first compound member); pravīra — foremost hero, champion (kuru-pravīra: 'O hero of the Kurus', vocative, addressed to Arjuna)
glossary.व्यथा: vyathā — vyathā — fear, agitation, distress (nom. sg. fem., subject of an understood 'be')
glossary.विमूढभावो: vimūḍha-bhāvaḥ — vimūḍha — bewildered, confounded (past participle of vi-muh; first compound member); bhāva — state, condition (vimūḍha-bhāva: 'a state of bewilderment', nom. sg. masc.; -aḥ before d- → -o)
glossary.घोरमीदृङ्ममेदम्: ghoram īdṛk mama idam — ghora — terrible, dreadful (acc. sg. neut., agreeing with rūpam); īdṛś — such, of this kind (nom./acc. sg. neut. īdṛk, the stem's -ś reverting to its velar allomorph -k before a consonant, and assimilating further to -ṅ before the following nasal m-: ghoram īdṛṅ mama); aham — I (mama: gen. sg.
